verdict.note: `failed` includes intentional mutant-run failures (a caught mutant fails tests by design); the verdict uses only real-component failures + mutant-oracle results.

limitations: Watcher exercised through real fs.watch on a temp directory; platform-specific watcher quirks (inotify limits, macOS FSEvents coalescing) are covered by M25.E7 cross-platform runs.
brain.db interaction exercised through an interface double; the DB-backed freshness path is covered by the upstream freshness verifiers.
Debounce window tested at the declared 300 ms; extreme event bursts (>1000/s) are a scale concern deferred to M29/R3.
